patch_description:
Reduce the ansatz from 24 parameters to 8-10 parameters through aggressive parameter sharing across qubits, combined with a sparse but effective entangling structure. Replace the linear CZ chain with a more symmetric connectivity pattern that creates meaningful multi-qubit correlations, and use parametrized two-qubit gates (XX/YY) to learn the entanglement.

Key changes:
1. Share RY parameters across multiple qubits (4 shared RY params instead of 8)
2. Replace fixed CZ chain with learnable XX/YY gates on strategic pairs
3. Use a symmetric connectivity pattern (even/odd qubits interact)
4. Remove redundant RZ layers (keep only one post-interaction RZ per qubit)
5. Target ~10 total parameters to enable learning from ~15 training examples

This reduces overfitting pressure while maintaining expressivity through targeted entanglement.
